name: Hiiragi Hotaru
source:
A war orphan who now works as a servant to the Hiirage family. He was thoroughly trained in cleaning, laundry, and cooking, and has since become skilled at all kinds of housework.

In [url=/v67527]Anthurium[/url], he began caring for [url=/c166998]Mio[/url] while dressed in women’s clothing because the latter felt uncomfortable around men.

His appearance leading people into mistaking him as woman.

At Aono Academy, the girls’ school he visits, he becomes caught up in a horrific incident.
